'''Yuledan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
Yuledan was captured in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the early stages of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. He was captured sometime before, or during, the [[Battle of Dibrook]] and brought to a [[Shaper research facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dibrook]]. Here, [[Master Shaper]] [[Nagme]] experimented on him. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tsalok]] later placed a [[tizowyrm]] in his ear to interrogate him about the whereabouts of Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Finn Galfridian]]. Tsalok placed a [[spineray]] on his back to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] him into giving the information. Yuledan resisted for several days, relying on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to sustain himself. However, he eventually broke down and told Tsalok Finn's name and that he was in training on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Tsalok then took Yuledan with him offworld when [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and refugee forces [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|breached]] the facility, forcing the Yuuzhan Vong to evacuate the Shapers. His [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was recovered by [[Kaye Galfridian]].

Tsalok took Yuledan and the shapers to [[Rychel]], a planet that had been conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong. Yuledan continued to be experimented on, but Nagme and the other Shapers did not want him to break, or else their plans for him would not succeed. They allowed Yuledan to escape from his confinement in order to keep his spirit up, and he acquired a weapon and attempted to kill Nagme. Tsalok intervened, picking up Yuledan and throwing him against a well, and was about to impale him upon an [[amphistaff]] before Nagme stopped him. She explained to him the situation, but Tsalok was determined that Yuledan would not touch her. He advanced on Yuledan, who raised his arms in defense, but Tsalok cut off his right hand in punishment.
